variant.description: 10x distribution variant. Selects the published image. See https://doc.log10x.com/engine/flavors

licenseJwt.description: 10x licence JWT. The engine does not start without a licence. Download from https://console.log10x.com

licenseSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the licence JWT. Takes precedence over licenseJwt.

licenseDelivery.description: How the licence reaches the engine: projected file (TENX_LICENSE_FILE) or environment variable (TENX_LICENSE_KEY).

enabled.description: Make the liveness and readiness probes observe the 10x engine, not just Filebeat.

stallSeconds.description: How long the engine may burn no CPU before the probes call it frozen.

readinessFilebeatTest.description: Which Filebeat test the readiness probe runs. 'output' cannot test output.file; use 'http' there.
